scientific_integrity: No extrapolation from enumeration to higher orders; all computations are included as complete standalone source. No external validation or publication priority is represented.
scientific_limitations: The frequency table is exhaustive only for binary de Bruijn cycles of order five, with rotations identified. The feedback-reversal identity holds for every binary order at least two. The programs independently enumerate the finite domain but do not constitute an external independent audit. Equivalent results under other names may exist.
title: The first non-universal reflection-complexity spectrum of binary de Bruijn cycles
